t: What does LDP price mean vs. FOB price in regards to getting pricing from a manufacturer? – Profade Apparel
s: October 30, 2019 - LDP means “landed- duty paid” price. The final price paid by a brand or retailer for finish goods including shipping, duty, delivery, insurance and customs clearance costs. FOB means “freight on board” price.
